title: C# Strings
description: Strings are used for storing text. A string variable contains a collection of characters surrounded by double quotes.

challenges.title: String Length
challenges.exercise: Print the length of the string 'Antigravity' using the Length property.

challenges.title: Upper Case
challenges.exercise: Print the string 'hello' in all upper case letters.

challenges.title: Concatenation
challenges.exercise: Concatenate 'First' and 'Last' using string.Concat() and print it.

challenges.title: Interpolation
challenges.exercise: Use string interpolation to print 'My name is John' using a variable name='John'.

challenges.title: Index Access
challenges.exercise: Print the first character of 'C# Master'.
